Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

AgriDesign 1.0.0

First public release.

Analysis

  • design_anova() analyses 16 designs (completely randomised, randomised complete blocks and generalised blocks, Latin, Graeco-Latin and Youden squares, incomplete blocks, augmented, factorials, split-, strip- and split-split-plots, nested) with covariates and transformations; every term is tested against its own error stratum.
  • ls_means(), compare_means() with eleven procedures and compact letters, simple effects with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom, trend(), test_contrasts() and waller_duncan().
  • check_assumptions(), transformations(), box_cox(), nonparametric(), durbin_test(), waerden_test() and median_test().
  • recover_interblock(): combined intra- and inter-block analysis by REML.

Planning

  • make_design() randomises 16 designs (uniform Latin squares by the Jacobson-Matthews chain; alpha and cyclic designs searched for the highest efficiency), field_book(), design_efficiency() and power_design().

Plant breeding and pathology

  • ammi(), stability(), line_tester(), diallel(), nc_design(), audpc(), audps(), audpc_by_unit(), smith_index() and hatheway_size().

Figures and report

  • plot() methods for every result, plot_interaction(), plot_cell_means(), plot_differences(), plot_ss_partition(), plot_field(), save_figure() and design_report().
